title: Guruvayoor
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt:
Details of Kshethram:Moolavar: Guruvaayurappan

Pushkarani: Narayana Saras

Travel: This kshethram is located in the town of Guruvayur in Kerala.

 

Sthala Puranam:

According to legend, Lord Guruvayurappan originated even before the start of Krita Yugam. There was once a couple who's names were Prsni and Suthapas who were desirous of having children. To have children, Prsni is said to have undertaken a vratham for twelve days in which she would offer the Lord milk and only have that milk. Afte
